item.title: Threat Hunting DLL Side-Loading from Social Lures
item.description: DLL side-loading is effective because it abuses trust. A signed or legitimate executable runs, Windows searches for a dependency, and the attacker places a malicious DLL where the executable will load it. To an analyst, the first process may look normal. The behavior around it is where the hunt gets interesting.
